## Schrödinger Acquires ENPICOM to Establish End-to-End Computational Platform for Biologics Discovery


11/25/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 122 KB](https://s203.q4cdn.com/609444515/files/doc_news/Schrdinger-Acquires-ENPICOM-to-Establish-End-to-End-Computational-Platform-for-Biologics-Discovery-2026.pdf)


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Schrödinger, Inc. (Nasdaq: SDGR) today announced the acquisition of ENPICOM B.V., a privately held company that provides a specialized bioinformatics software platform for early-stage biologics discovery.


Early-stage biologics discovery generates billions of genetic sequences, creating an operational bottleneck between wet-lab screening and downstream molecular design. ENPICOM automates these complex sequencing pipelines, using integrated sequence analytics and machine learning to filter billions of possibilities down to a refined, prioritized list of drug candidates in hours rather than weeks. By funneling prioritized candidates directly into LiveDesign for Biologics, with integrated access to Schrödinger’s suite of physics-based optimization methods, Schrödinger can expand the end-to-end coverage of its biologics discovery platform, deepen enterprise customer engagement, and capture high-volume sequence data to further advance predictive modeling method development.


“ENPICOM’s innovative solutions are a strategic addition to our computational platform, and this acquisition demonstrates our commitment to establishing the same leadership position for biologics that we have achieved for small molecules," said Ramy Farid, Ph.D., chief executive officer at Schrödinger. “Uniting ENPICOM’s bioinformatics software with our computational platform and enterprise solutions will enable us to support biologics discovery campaigns from initial screening through atomic-scale optimization, while providing the underlying architecture to further expand into new modalities. We look forward to welcoming the talented ENPICOM team to Schrödinger.”


“ENPICOM and Schrödinger share a common foundation of scientific rigor, and we are very pleased to join the Schrödinger team,” stated Nicola Bonzanni, chief executive officer and founder of ENPICOM. “Our bioinformatics platform turns weeks of complex sequence analysis into hours of decisive insight, matching software and automation directly to the needs of biologics discovery teams. Working alongside Schrödinger’s experienced scientific team will help further advance the ENPICOM technology, while their strong commercial team can scale the reach of our biologics platform across the biopharmaceutical industry.”


Schrödinger and ENPICOM closed the approximately €22 million all-cash acquisition on November 25, 2026, and ENPICOM is now operating as part of Schrödinger. The acquisition is not expected to materially impact Schrödinger’s full-year 2026 ACV, and the company is reaffirming its full-year 2026 ACV guidance provided on November 4, 2026.


**About ENPICOM**


ENPICOM is a bioinformatics and AI company accelerating biologics discovery and development. Its digital platform unifies data, automates analysis, and integrates AI into scientists' daily workflows, helping life sciences organizations develop better medicines, faster. The company is headquartered in 's-Hertogenbosch, the Netherlands, on the Mariënburg Campus, premises shared with the Jheronimus Academy of Data Science (JADS), placing it at the heart of a leading data science ecosystem in Europe. For more information, visit[www.enpicom.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.enpicom.com&esheet=54645931&newsitemid=20261124467594&lan=en-US&anchor=www.enpicom.com&index=1&md5=2c5715c0d663bca33f168e7d3bb8d693) .


**About Schrödinger**


Schrödinger is transforming molecular discovery with its computational platform, which enables the discovery of novel, highly optimized molecules for drug development and materials design. Schrödinger’s software platform is built on more than 30 years of R&D investment and is licensed by biotechnology, pharmaceutical and industrial companies, and academic institutions around the world. Schrödinger also leverages the platform to advance a portfolio of collaborative and proprietary programs. To learn more, visit[www.schrodinger.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.schrodinger.com&esheet=54645931&newsitemid=20261124467594&lan=en-US&anchor=www.schrodinger.com&index=2&md5=ad98d4b74e254bec75fc5e5eef9a3dc9) , follow us on LinkedIn, or visit our blog,[Extrapolations.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2FExtrapolations.com&esheet=54645931&newsitemid=20261124467594&lan=en-US&anchor=Extrapolations.com&index=3&md5=85e7a8fe8883b2e9e5c57daeacc3041c) .
